titleText: Mohammed Ali, 10, killed at home in Sudan while getting ready for school
mainText: From Times of Malta: Mohammed Ali, 10, killed at home in Sudan while getting ready for school. 'Any parent in Malta who got their child ready for school this morning will understand what this family has lost': Karl Schembri, NRC humanitarian

titleText: Researchers are mapping Malta’s hidden underground world, one cave at a time
mainText: From Times of Malta: Researchers are mapping Malta’s hidden underground world, one cave at a time. Researchers are using cutting-edge technology to uncover crumbling caverns and tunnels used in violent crimes

titleText: Another mobile phone discovered in prison cell during night raid
mainText: From MaltaToday: Another mobile phone discovered in prison cell during night raid. Another mobile phone has been found in an inmate’s cell in the Corradino Correctional Facility (CCF). In a Facebook post on Tuesday night, Home Affairs Minister Glenn Bedingfield said “another phone” was found during a raid in a prison cell.

titleText: Agency to implement Malta in Motion strategy to be established in 2027 – Bonett
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Agency to implement Malta in Motion strategy to be established in 2027 – Bonett. An agency dedicated to implementing the Malta in Motion strategy will be established during 2027, Sustainable Mobility Minister Chris Bonett announced, as he outlined plans to improve Malta's transport system.

titleText: Government plans to set up Malta in Motion agency in 2027
mainText: From MaltaToday: Government plans to set up Malta in Motion agency in 2027. Government plans to set up an agency during 2027 to deliver Malta in Motion, Transport Minister Chris Bonett has revealed.
